svg.title: Alberta electricity: shop the energy line, not the whole bill
svg.desc: The UCA Cost Comparison Tool compares energy rate, admin fees, term, and exit fees. Delivery stays with your distributor. Rate of Last Resort energy is about 12.0112.06 ¢/kWh through 31 December 2026 depending on the default retailer. Cooling-off is 10 calendar days; a switch can take 1090 days.
svg.text: Alberta: you shop energy, not delivery
UCA Cost Comparison Tool workflow. RoLR energy ~12.0112.06 ¢/kWh to 31 Dec 2026. Verified 20 Sep 2026.
Enter your usage. Shortlist three. Call.
RoLR has no exit fee to leave
A cheap ¢ ad can lose on $8/mo fees.
Default electricity: Rate of Last Resort (ex-RRO) through 31 Dec 2026  EPCOR 12.01, ENMAX 12.06, Direct Energy Regulated Services 12.02 ¢/kWh (UCA tables; zone-specific).
Cooling-off: 10 calendar days on a competitive contract (phone contracts can have a longer window). Switch timing: 1090 calendar days. Keep paying the old retailer until the flip.
Source: ucahelps.alberta.ca Cost Comparison Tool, default rates, and how-to-switch pages. Education only  not a retailer endorsement.
